entry_gate: Run only after B2 probability architecture survives 2024 fixed confirmation.
deployable_price_requirement: timestamped pre-race offered odds; final_sp cannot establish deployable POT
anti_overfit_rules: No threshold may be selected using 2024 or sealed years.
Candidate must have at least 100 development bets.
Positive development POT must not be supplied by one year or one odds band.
Confirmation requires positive 2024 POT and non-catastrophic drawdown.
Deployment claim requires separate timestamp-safe offered-odds evidence.
